conclusion: Candidate implementation covers core JSONL persistence and SQLite temporal graph skeleton, but formal MCP redo is incomplete and implementation has blocking scope-isolation gaps.
blockingGaps: PersistentNarrationMemoryStore.retrieve does not isolate by packet.session_id or packet.module_id.
SQLiteNarrationGraphMemory entity_id uses only patch path, so facts from different sessions/modules supersede each other.
Graph store is manual ingest only and not integrated into NarrationPipeline.
Patch memory source_event_ids lose per-patch granularity in write_from_record.
Formal redo run still needs plan/architecture/rubric/grading/dispatch/execution/validation/qa/final assessment and two-hour evidence.
recommendations: Promote session/module scope isolation to must-have.
Add tests for same path in different sessions/modules not cross-retrieving or superseding.

Tree rubrics must include non-authoritative boundary, scope isolation, persistence reload, soft invalidation audit, graph provenance, supersession, pipeline integration, tests/offline regression, dirty worktree protection.
Run focused offline narration tests before final assessment.
